{{Quote|Massive explosions in all engine-control centers. Possible thermal detonators; massive damage; massive casualties. Contact has been lost with the bridge; no indication of explosions there. All command level doors have been sealed; all turbolift cars are frozen and locked down.|Unidentified damage-control officer to Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="Choices" />}}
A '''damage control officer''' served aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]<ref name="Choices" /> sometime in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> After [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] sabotaged the ''Chimaera'' with explosives, senior bridge officer [[Gilad Pellaeon]] requested a situation report via [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. The damage-control officer responded by informing Pellaeon that the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] engine-control centers had suffered massive damage and casualties.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The damage-control officer appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
